entries.name: type
entries.description: Get the type. The type.name is an alternative that returns a string indicating the type (i.e., integer, double, string, Boolean, etc.). This is an integer that is one of following values.

entries.name: type.index
entries.description: Get the type index. This is a unique integer representing each pointer type and can be used to distinguish different pointers from one another.

entries.name: type.name
entries.description: Get the type name. This is the string name of the type (i.e., integer, double, string, Boolean, etc.). The type is an alternative that returns an integer indicating the type.

entries.name: type.pointer
entries.description: Get the type name of a pointer. This can be useful in distinguishing pointers from one another (e.g., array from vector pointers).

entries.name: type.pointer.id
entries.description: Get the ID of a pointer.

entries.name: type.pointer.name
entries.description: Get the name of a pointer. This may be either the type name returned by type.pointer or a specific name, depending on the thing in question.
